Q: Is the A/C compressor relay in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 4.

STEP 4. Check the magnetic clutch operation.
Connect the battery (+) terminal to the compressor magnetic 
clutch connector terminal 1; <2.4L engine>/terminal 4; <3.0L 
engine>, and ground the battery (-) terminal to the body of the 
compressor. 
Q: Can the sound of the magnetic clutch (click) be heard?
YES : Go to Step 5.
NO : Replace. Then go to Step 11.
